# Search the context more broadly for any write-capable tool
# Let's look at the portion between request and tool 1 to see what instructions/tools were given
r = await CONTEXT.read(2300, 300)
print("Before tool 1:")
print(r)

print("\n\n")

# Let's also look for the word "write" as a tool name
r2 = await CONTEXT.search('"write"')
print('"write" occurrences:', r2["items"][:5] if r2["items"] else "none")

print("\n\n")

# Let's check the whole context for tool names that might be write-capable
# Search for all tool calls patterns
import re
tool_calls = set()
for offset in range(0, 126668, 500):
    chunk = await CONTEXT.read(offset, 500)
    # Find [tool N] tool_name
    matches = re.findall(r'\[tool \d+\] (\w+)', chunk)
    for m in matches:
        tool_calls.add(m)

print("Unique tool names called:", sorted(tool_calls))
